race_courses.name: Virginia Capital Trail, Four Mile Creek, 5 km out and back
race_courses.start_note: Start and finish on the trail beside the Four Mile Creek Trailhead; run east toward Jamestown.

route_guide.getting_there: Park at the Four Mile Creek Trailhead on New Market Road (Route 5). Restrooms and water are at the trailhead. The start line is on the trail beside the lot.

race_courses.start_note: Start and finish on the trail beside the Four Mile Creek Trailhead; run east toward Jamestown.

route_guide.getting_there: Park at the Four Mile Creek Trailhead on New Market Road (Route 5). Restrooms and water are at the trailhead. The start line is on the trail beside the lot.

race_courses.name: Virginia Capital Trail, Four Mile Creek to Herring Creek, half-marathon distance
race_courses.start_note: Start beside the Four Mile Creek Trailhead and run east; the finish is on the trail just past the Herring Creek Trailhead. Needs a car at each end.

route_guide.getting_there: Park at the Four Mile Creek Trailhead on New Market Road (Route 5). Restrooms and water are at the trailhead. The start line is on the trail beside the lot.

race_courses.name: Virginia Capital Trail, Great Shiplock Park east, marathon distance
race_courses.start_note: Start at Great Shiplock Park and run east; the finish is on the trail near Herring Creek. Needs a car at each end.

route_guide.getting_there: Park at Great Shiplock Park on Dock Street. The start line is on the trail at the park; run east, away from the closed section toward the Floodwall.

race_courses.name: Virginia Capital Trail, Great Shiplock Park east, 50 km
race_courses.start_note: Start at Great Shiplock Park and run east; the finish is on the trail near Charles City Courthouse. Needs a car at each end.

route_guide.getting_there: Park at Great Shiplock Park on Dock Street. The start line is on the trail at the park; run east, away from the closed section toward the Floodwall.

race_courses.name: Virginia Capital Trail, marathon distance to Jamestown
race_courses.start_note: Start on the trail about 1.3 km east of the Herring Creek Trailhead and run east; the finish is beside the Jamestown Trailhead lot at the end of the trail. Needs a car at each end.

route_guide.getting_there: Park at the Herring Creek Trailhead and walk about 1.3 km east along the trail to the start line. The finish is at the Jamestown Trailhead lot by Jamestown Settlement, at the end of the trail.
